prompt: Edit this PixelForge homepage design comp with exactly one factual correction. Preserve the entire layout, colors, typography, images, all other text and controls. initialPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Render one high-fidelity PixelForge Chinese desktop product homepage, edge-to-edge, wide desktop aspect ratio, no browser chrome or devices. The attached existing workspace is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: inherit sage off-white surfaces, forest-green ink and actions, precise quiet controls and the PixelForge wordmark; do not copy its composition or text. The actual product converts STATIC images LOCALLY; supports 14 export formats, batch conversion, adjustable quality/size, before-after preview and ZIP download. HEIC is INPUT ONLY. Use these exact simple Chinese words, optimized to remove slogans: heading “在本地转换图片格式”; description “支持 14 种格式导出，可批量调整画质和尺寸。图片无需上传。”; main action “开始转换”; secondary action “试用示例”. Navigation “首页 / 转换工作台 / 格式支持 / 使用指南”. Keep all controls clearly readable, plausible to implement as semantic HTML. NO compression numbers, NO file size numbers, NO percentages, NO testimonials, NO professional-printing or lossless-everywhere claims, NO benefit badge row, NO equal icon-card feature row. Do not substitute the supplied exact heading with a new slogan. A single dominant compositional move, generous whitespace, realistic complete page and the beginning of its lower section. The reference palette and type character stay fixed. COMPOSITION C: Lead with a bold full-width format chooser as the working introduction itself. A spacious headline strip and navigation sit above a large asymmetric typographic output list at the LEFT, JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, with a quiet selected WebP highlight. This output list is integrated into a broad image ribbon crossing the entire page BELOW the headline, not placed as a right-hand product card beside copy. The image ribbon shows one still image flowing through source “PNG” to “WebP”, with a thumb-sized source sample, a generously sized landscape result, then one clearly placed “开始转换” action. File format names, image subject, whitespace and green selection provide the visual focal point; there are no diagrams with decorative arrows, no faux 3D objects. Begin the next section as a compact readable format-support table labeled “查看格式支持”, columns “格式 / 导入 / 导出”, and accurately show HEIC / HEIF only as 导入. No invented metrics. Create an ambitious but believable website surface, not a poster.
